coupling.rationale: Server and client code are cleanly separated behind query functions and prop-driven components — textbook SolidStart v2. The seam is narrow but untyped: loaders return `any` and components accept `any`, so the contract is convention, not compiler-enforced.

abstraction_design.rationale: Abstractions match the app's real variation: one card component, one shared card-list builder, data-driven relation table. The gap is page-level scaffolding (count + grid + not-found pattern) that gets copied three or four times instead of componentized.

findings.issue: Every loader returns untyped objects and every route consumes `props.data: any` (e.g. routes/pokemon/[name].tsx:43, routes/types/[name].tsx:13), so the server→client contract is invisible; renaming a loader key breaks templates silently, and tsconfig's `strict: true` never checks the boundary.
findings.suggestion: Define result interfaces in lib/types.ts, type each loadX function's return, and add a `"typecheck": "tsc --noEmit"` script to package.json.

findings.issue: Card sprite URLs are hand-constructed from IDs in two places (api.ts:86 in toSpeciesCards, api.ts:128 in loadHomeData) instead of taken from the API's `sprites.front_default`; a species whose default Pokémon resolves differently needs the same fix twice, and the home loader has no Pokémon records to derive it from.
findings.suggestion: Resolve the sprite in one place — e.g. a buildCards(speciesList, pokemonRefs?) helper used by loadHomeData too, or store the default variety's sprite URL on the species during loadHomeData assembly.

findings.issue: The nested `Show when={data()} fallback={Show when={data()===null} → NotFound}` loading/not-found idiom is copy-pasted in all four detail routes.
findings.suggestion: Extract a small `<DetailPage data={data()}>{(d) => …}` (or `<ShowData>`/`<NotFoundBoundary>`) component in components/.

findings.issue: No `typecheck` (or lint) script; the build (`vite build`) doesn't run tsc, so the strict tsconfig is never enforced anywhere.
findings.suggestion: Add `"typecheck": "tsc --noEmit"` and run it in CI.

findings.issue: Filtering re-runs `humanize(s.name).toLowerCase()` over all 1025 species on every keystroke/memo recompute, inside the route component; a future change to search semantics means editing an inline 10-line predicate embedded in JSX-adjacent code.
findings.suggestion: Precompute a lowercased display name on each species in loadHomeData (api.ts) and keep the filter predicate small and pure.

summary: A well-layered, current-idiom SolidStart v2 app: server-only data assembly in one module, query/server-function wrappers, and prop-driven components make features easy to find, delete and extend. The main editability costs are the complete absence of types on loader results (the server→client contract is convention only), a sprite-URL rule duplicated in two places, and a few copy-pasted page scaffolds (not-found pattern, count+card-grid block).
